title: Crichton Castle (Mountainous Landscape with a Rainbow)
credit: Yale Center for British Art via Google Cultural Institute
caption_long: Paint a mountainous valley opening toward a faint castle on a sunlit ridge, with a broad pale rainbow arcing through storm-dark sky. Cool indigo and charcoal washes melt into warm ochre hills; the castle is only a pinkish silhouette in wet haze. Let paper white glow through thin watercolor so the light feels just-cleared after rain, romantic and airy rather than heroic.
caption_short: a pale castle under a washed rainbow after mountain rain.

title: Buttermere Lake, with Part of Cromackwater, Cumberland, a Shower
credit: Art UK / Tate collection photograph on Wikimedia Commons
caption_long: Paint a silver mountain lake after a passing shower: dark fells recede into blue mist while a thin, luminous rainbow lifts over still water. Keep the light wet and pearly, the shoreline almost dissolving, a few small figures only as scale. Use thin atmospheric glazes and pale paper shine so the scene feels hushed, cool, and newly washed rather than storm-dark.
caption_short: a silver lake and thin rainbow after a mountain shower.

title: The Lake of Zug
license_note: The Met Open Access API marks this object as public domain.
caption_long: Create a Swiss lake at first light: pale lemon sky melting into milky water, distant peaks half-erased by blue haze, a faint rainbow barely there. Tiny shore figures and a small boat keep the vastness human. Use translucent watercolor with scraped highlights and gouache bloom so the mountains feel like breath, the whole sheet luminous, soft, and weather-soaked.
caption_short: a misted alpine lake in pale lemon light with a faint rainbow.

provenance.source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access
provenance.repository: Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York, NY
provenance.medium: Watercolor and bodycolor (gouache) with reductive techniques over graphite

title: The Red Rigi
credit: National Gallery of Victoria via Google Cultural Institute
caption_long: Paint sunrise on an alpine lake: a mountain blushing rose and gold while the water holds a quieter echo of the same light. Soft boats and a low shoreline sit in cool shadow; the sky is washed peach into pale blue. Use wet watercolor, gouache bloom, and scratched sparkle so the mountain feels distant and tender, the air still and just waking.
caption_short: a rose-gold alpine peak at sunrise over a quiet lake.

title: Boboli Garden, Florence
license_note: The Met Open Access API marks this object as public domain.
caption_long: Paint a pale garden statue resting in a bower of deep green and umber leaves, struck by sudden Italian sun. Leave paper white on the stone and grass; let wet foliage washes stay translucent and dappled. A little lavender in the shadowed marble, warm ochre in the shade. Loose watercolor and gouache, elegant and airy, as if the garden is breathing heat.
caption_short: a sunlit garden statue half-hidden in loose leafy watercolor.

provenance.source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access
provenance.repository: Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York, NY
provenance.medium: Watercolor, gouache, and graphite on white wove paper, mounted on board

title: Garden near Lucca
license_note: The Met Open Access API marks this object as public domain.
caption_long: Paint a sun-warmed stone garden urn on a tall pedestal against a wide lavender sky. A green vine with small violet flowers climbs the right edge; graphite still shows in the carved garlands. Cream highlights, ochre shadow, airy watercolor so the stone feels hot and the sky thin. Mediterranean noon, romantic and unlabored.
caption_short: a sunlit stone urn and climbing flowers against a lavender sky.

provenance.source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access
provenance.repository: Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York, NY
provenance.medium: Watercolor and graphite on white wove paper

title: The Tyrol
caption_long: Paint a high alpine ridge in dry, airy watercolor: one slender pine on a pale rocky ledge, then receding peaks in lavender, blue-gray, and warm terracotta. Let wet-into-wet slopes blur; keep the sky almost paper. Cool high-altitude light, quiet and spacious, more breath than geology. Cream wove paper showing through gouache sparkle on snow.
caption_short: a solitary pine before soft lavender Tyrolean peaks.

title: In the Generalife
license_note: The Met Open Access API marks this object as public domain.
caption_long: Paint three women in a shaded Andalusian garden: one at a wooden easel, one in a wide cream hat leaning in, one resting in deep leaf-shadow. Dappled sun breaks the dark green canopy; the ground is loose cobble in gray and tan. Watercolor, wax, and graphite, intimate and unposed, cool shade with sudden light, a private afternoon among foliage.
caption_short: women painting in a dappled garden, cool shade and sudden sun.

provenance.source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access
provenance.repository: Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York, NY
provenance.medium: Watercolor, wax crayon, and graphite on white wove paper

title: View of a Park
license_note: The Met Open Access API marks this object as public domain.
caption_long: Paint an eighteenth-century park in pale gray wash: tall cypress-like trees, a few walkers, a parasol, statues dissolving into mist. Touch in the softest green and pink so color feels remembered, not applied. Cream paper, chalk structure, airy leisure. Keep it light and dreamlike, an Italian garden recalled rather than surveyed.
caption_short: a misted park with cypresses, walkers, and a pale parasol.

provenance.source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access
provenance.repository: Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York, NY
provenance.medium: Black chalk with gray wash and touches of green and pink watercolor over pencil underdrawing; verso: black chalk.

title: Landscape with Road and Monument
license_note: The Met Open Access API marks this object as public domain.
caption_long: Paint a pale sepia park: feathery trees, a slender monument with a tiny statue, a carriage waiting, small figures strolling toward open light. Use pencil and the thinnest brown wash so foliage feels like breath on cream paper. Diffused afternoon, elegant and unhurried, more air than ink.
caption_short: a pale sepia park with feathery trees and a slender monument.

provenance.source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access
provenance.repository: Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York, NY

title: Flower Garden and Bungalow, Bermuda
license_note: The Met Open Access API marks this object as public domain.
caption_long: Paint a Bermuda garden spilling red and yellow blooms toward a lemon bungalow with a stepped white roof. Broad tropical leaves, a quiet turquoise bay, soft gray-blue cloud. Leave the roof almost paper-white; keep washes fluid and sun-warm, not heavy. Light, coastal, and gently inhabited.
caption_short: a lemon bungalow and bright garden above a quiet turquoise bay.

provenance.repository: Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York, NY
provenance.medium: Watercolor and graphite on off-white wove paper

title: Fishing Boats, Key West
license_note: The Met Open Access API marks this object as public domain.
caption_long: Paint pale fishing boats at rest on clear Key West water, their hulls and masts barely drawn over turquoise and sand-colored shallows. A high, open sky, almost empty. Use thin watercolor so the sea stays transparent and the boats feel weightless. Hot quiet noon, airy and salt-clean, more light than labor.
caption_short: pale fishing boats floating on thin turquoise Key West water.

title: A Woman Seated at a Bench on the Avenue du Bois
license_note: The Met Open Access API marks this object as public domain.
caption_long: Paint a woman in a park from behind, navy dress and straw hat with a yellow ribbon, holding a large cerulean parasol. A sandy path, loose emerald trees, a hint of carriage in the distance. Watercolor over faint graphite, breezy and unfinished, summer air showing through the paper. Elegant, light, and quickly seen.
caption_short: a woman with a blue parasol on a sun-bleached park path.

title: Gold and Brown: Dordrecht
license_note: The Met Open Access API marks this object as public domain.
caption_long: Paint a wide, hazy river in gold and brown washes: a few sailboats, a low far shore, almost no skyline. Horizontal strokes of diluted cream, sepia, and pale gray; dark sails as the only weight. Quiet tonal light, like late afternoon fog lifting. Keep it spare, soft, and nocturnal in mood even in daylight.
caption_short: sailboats on a gold-brown river in thin tonal watercolor.
